metadata.name: Save a file to a folder
metadata.description: Use “Save a file to a folder” in Recued. Save a file the user sent, such as an attachment on their email, into one of their folders. Pass its id (file:…) and the folder as the user named it: Receipts, or a path like documents/Receipts. It never replaces a file: a taken name gets a number. Tell the user where it went.
metadata.author: recued-core

file_id.label: File
file_id.help: The file's id, as the files attached to the message list it (file:…).

folder.label: Folder
folder.help: The folder, the way the user named it: a connected folder (documents), a folder inside one (Receipts), or a path from a connected folder (documents/Receipts/2026). My folders lists them.

file_name.label: Save as
file_name.help: A file name to save it under instead of its own, without a folder in it. Leave empty to keep its own name.
